resources.string: On-device encryption
For extra security, your passwords and passkeys can be encrypted on your device before they’re saved to your Google Account.
On a new device, you’ll unlock them with your Google Account password or the screen lock of a device you already use.
Set up
On-device encryption is on
Your passwords and passkeys are encrypted on your device before they’re saved to your Google Account.
To use your passwords and passkeys on this phone, verify it’s you.

This can’t be turned off later. The only way back is to delete every password saved in this Google account, on all your devices. On a new device, you’ll unlock your passwords with your Google Account password or a screen lock.
This permanently deletes every password and saved Wi-Fi network in this Google account, on all your devices, and turns off on-device encryption.
This permanently deletes all passkeys saved to this Google account. You’ll need to create new passkeys for your online accounts.
